item.description:
### Added - **Window Snapper** — snap windows with magnetic edges & corners, a Top Edge Panel with frosted glass panes for filling empty slots, customizable per-display grids with a 1:1 on-screen divider editor, smooth window glide animations, hold-to-preview keyboard shortcuts (plus a Rectangle-style preset), 1:1 on-screen previews on style & trigger controls, and one-click Workspace Profiles with shortcut toggle-restore and display auto-apply - **Appearance (Text Size)** — choose **Small**, **Standard**, **Large**, or **Extra Large** text in Settings to scale typography live across windows, popovers, the JSON editor, and HUDs - **Compact Window & Navigation** — shrink Toolbox down to `340×300 pt` with an auto-collapsing sidebar, switch between **Compact** and **Detailed** Dashboard cards, and navigate back/forward via mouse buttons, swipes, toolbar arrows, or `⌘ [` / `⌘ ]` - **Clipboard & Keyboard Lock** — drag or press `⌘ ↑` / `⌘ ↓` to reorder pinned clipboard items (driving `⌘ 1–9` quick paste), and lock input for up to **5 minutes** in Keyboard Lock
### Changed - **Visual & Readability Refresh** — consistent dark theme across every Mac, higher-contrast cards, switches, badges, and buttons, larger HUD toasts, subtle press feedback, and clearer minimum text sizes - **Status Bar Menu & Popovers** — upgraded frosted popover backdrops with hover highlights, smooth section collapse/expand keeping switches anchored, Clipboard split into **Pinned** and **Recent** sections, and redesigned Keep Awake, Keyboard Lock, Call Controls, Scroll Direction, and Settings layouts
### Fixed - **Window Snapper** — eliminated false unsnaps while selecting text, stabilized Electron/custom-titlebar drags and single-resize unsnap restoration, prevented accidental Top Edge Panel opens when dragging down from Maximize, and ensured `⌫`/`Esc` cleanly cancels keyboard snap previews - **Status Bar Menu & Modules** — kept the menu-bar popover from pulling Dashboard forward or jumping height when paused, fixed case-insensitive Dock exclusions, disabled actions with clear hints while paused, and cleaned up Shortcut Recorder focus handling
